title: 법관의 국제기구 파견 등에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
title_original: 법관의 국제기구 파견 등에 관한 규칙
full_text:
Article 2 (Secondment)
(1) The Chief Justice of the Supreme Court may second a judge, upon the judge's application or consent, to an international organization, foreign government, or research institute (hereinafter referred to as an "international organization, etc.") where necessary for performing duties and developing professional capabilities at such an institution.
(2) The period of secondment under paragraph (1) shall be the period necessary for the performance of duties and development of professional capabilities.
